pluginText.pf.messages: {"never":"texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results or the chiropractor's name (on a house call the chiropractor's name stays, for the door check); X-rays and results never go through Rosie","staff":"texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials only (A.M., never Alex M.) and never the reason for the visit","healthQuestions":"Rosie never answers a health question, like ice or heat; it goes to the clinic, which calls the patient","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian","decider":"for an adult who can't consent, the texts go to the person who decides, and the code to whoever meets the chiropractor"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"licenses":"each chiropractor's own license, per state; an acupuncturist's own license","skills":"chiropractors: exams, adjustments, reading X-rays, kinesio taping; prenatal care only by a chiropractor trained for it (here Dr. Chen); the front desk: check-in, plan checks, estimates and payment; only people cleared for house calls go to homes and workplaces","supervision":"a chiropractic assistant (taping, hot and cold packs) works only while a chiropractor is there, as the state's rules allow (a switch)","oks":"the owner OKs same-day visits, any price made for one patient (at the clinic, every one, like a custom brace; for house calls, over $500, like a care plan's total), and anything a chiropractor flags","standIn":"a chiropractor out: another chiropractor takes their patients where there's room, and the patient chooses; the patient never hears why someone is out","away":"the house-call team: Dr. Brooks and Dr. Moore, each with a portable table"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"records":"chiropractic records are kept by the clinic as long as the state's rules require (a child's may be kept longer); a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the clinic's records","copies":"a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records","consent":"written consent after the main risks are explained, before any care, where the state's rules require it (a switch)","prepaid":"prepaid visits and packages follow the state's rules (written terms, a cancel, a refund of unused visits): a switch; the example clinic sells none","showLicense":"the license shown where the state asks: posted at the clinic, and on a house call","minors":"who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)","host":"a workplace care day only under the employer's written OK and its sign-in rules (S1-58, B4-66)","ads":"no free-visit or price claims the state's rules don't allow","privacy":"health privacy rules for every message and form"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"lateArrival":"up to 15 minutes late: still seen, in the time left; later: the front desk may move the visit, with no fee (Rosie never moves it itself)","standIn":"a chiropractor out: another chiropractor with room, or new times with no fee","forms":"a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page before any care), moves it, or cancels with no fee (A7-74, B7-61)","planChange":"the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay, or a free cancel","redFlagBefore":"red-flag words texted before a visit: the emergency room message, the owner is told and calls, and the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee","referral":"something in the exam needs a medical doctor first: no adjustment, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names","carePlan":"a care plan's visits are booked only with the patient's own yes; one reply stops any visit or all that are left; no sales texts","twoBookings":"a patient with several care plan visits open: Rosie asks which one before any change","healthQuestion":"a question about ice, heat or exercises before the visit goes to the clinic; Rosie gives no advice","urgent":"no service is sent now and nobody is on call (S2-30, S2-31): sudden back pain gets the soonest same-day time, with the owner's OK; the red-flag words get the emergency room or 911 message","other":"all other edge cases the generic way"}
